sources.title: Towards Grounded GI Endoscopy VQA via Multi-Task Learning on Small VLMs
sources.snippet: Gastrointestinal (GI) endoscopic image analysis has shifted from single-label classification toward visual question answering (VQA), where a model must answer free-form clinical questions about an image.
